tools.name: taskhold_begin
tools.description: Start work in one call: files a new task (or takes an existing one with task_id), plans its steps, marks it in progress and starts the first step. Use this whenever the person asks for something: it puts the request on their board with a checklist and a progress bar. Returns the task id, the numbere

tools.name: taskhold_list
tools.description: List top-level tasks, one line each, grouped by status. Pass project to see one repo's work. Each line has status, title, steps done, progress and id; steps aren't listed (taskhold_get shows them). An unknown project name returns no tasks and is not created.

tools.name: taskhold_get
tools.description: Get one task in full: status, priority, project, labels, repeat, time worked and waited on the person, description, numbered steps with ids and summaries, the 10 latest notes, the completion summary and what changed (files, checks, links, risks, how to verify). Unknown ids fail with "Task not found"

tools.name: taskhold_get_current
tools.description: Get the task in progress (in this project when you pass project), with its steps and the next one to do. Call this at the start of a session. Returns the most recently active in-progress task, its numbered steps with ids (with descriptions and the summaries of done steps), the next step's id, projec

tools.name: taskhold_next
tools.description: Work the list as a queue: takes the next To Do task (highest priority, then oldest by default) and starts it and its first step. Atomic: no 2 agents get the same task. Returns the task, steps, project notes and next call, or that To Do is empty.

tools.name: taskhold_search
tools.description: Search tasks and steps by text in the title or description (case-insensitive, up to 100 tasks scanned). Returns matching lines grouped by status, with ids (a step names the task it belongs to), or a line saying nothing matched.

tools.name: taskhold_create
tools.description: File work for later (a bug, a follow-up, a chore); it lands in To Do. To file and start at once: taskhold_begin. parent_task_id adds one step to a task (taskhold_plan for several). Returns id, status and priority. Fails on an unknown parent_task_id or a step as parent, an unknown project_id (pass pr

tools.name: taskhold_plan
tools.description: Add ordered steps (subtasks) to a task so the person sees a checklist; the progress bar fills as steps finish. taskhold_begin already does this for new work. For an existing task: taskhold_start it, then taskhold_plan. Steps don't nest. Returns the task's whole step list with ids. Fails on an unknow

tools.name: taskhold_progress
tools.description: Move the person's progress bar during a long step or a task without steps: percent, or current and total (e.g. 12 of 40 files), plus a short message about what's happening now. On a task with steps, the steps drive the bar: numbers you send for the task go to its running step. Call at milestones, ev

tools.name: taskhold_create_from_todo
tools.description: Create a task from a TODO comment in code, keeping the file path and line number (label todo-from-code plus any labels you pass; priority as in taskhold_create; use taskhold_create for anything else). Returns the new task with its id and code location. Fails at the account's task ceiling or on an in

tools.name: taskhold_start
tools.description: Mark a task or step in progress when you begin it. Starting a step also starts its task. For new work, taskhold_begin files, plans and starts in one call. Returns the id, status and the next step's id when it has steps. Safe to repeat; it also resumes a blocked or done task. An unknown task_id fails

tools.name: taskhold_complete
tools.description: Mark a task or step done, with a summary of what you did and, optionally, a structured outcome: files changed (with +/- line counts), checks run (pass/fail/skip), links (PR, commit, branch, deploy, doc), follow-up task ids, risks and how the person can verify it. The person sees it as a What changed

tools.name: taskhold_block
tools.description: Mark a task (or step) blocked when you can't continue without the person (a decision, missing info, access). Returns the question and the exact taskhold_updates call to wait with. Write the reason as one question they can answer from the board in a line, e.g. "Decide: drop the legacy column or keep

tools.name: taskhold_unblock
tools.description: Move a blocked task back to todo once the blocker is resolved (taskhold_start resumes it directly). Returns the task with status todo. A task that isn't blocked is left as it is and the reply says its status; an unknown task_id fails with "Task not found".

tools.name: taskhold_release
tools.description: Put unfinished work back in To Do, with a note, when you stop and nobody has to answer (e.g. waiting on a captcha). Its steps go too, your label comes off, progress stays. Need the person? taskhold_block. Done tasks are refused.

tools.name: taskhold_update
tools.description: Change a task's title, description, priority, project or repeat; only fields you pass change. Status goes through taskhold_start, taskhold_complete, taskhold_block and taskhold_release. Returns the task. Fails on an unknown task_id or project_id (pass project by name).

tools.name: taskhold_add_note
tools.description: Add a note to a task: findings, decisions, what you tried. The person reads these. Notes are append-only and shown oldest first (taskhold_get shows the latest 10). Returns a one-line confirmation; an unknown task_id fails with "Task not found".

tools.name: taskhold_set_priority
tools.description: Change a task's priority. Returns the task title and new priority; an unknown task_id fails with "Task not found".

tools.name: taskhold_updates
tools.description: What the person changed since you last looked: replies (notes), new tasks, priority changes, unblocks. Call when you resume, between steps, and after blocking (with wait, until the reply lands). Pass the last cursor you got (from any call) as since. Your own changes are hidden unless include_agent i

tools.name: taskhold_list_projects
tools.description: List projects with their open work, one line each. You rarely need this: every tool takes project as a name. Each line has the name, open counts (working, blocked, todo) and id. With project: that project's notes.

tools.name: taskhold_create_project
tools.description: Create a project (a group of tasks, usually one per repo). Optional: any tool that takes project creates it on first use. A project with this name (any case) comes back unchanged, and the reply says if your description or color wasn't applied. Says whether it was created, restored or already existed

tools.name: taskhold_update_project
tools.description: Change a project's name, description, color or project notes. Only fields you pass change. Returns the project as it is now. Fails on an unknown project (it is never created here), on a name another project already has, or with nothing to change.

tools.name: taskhold_list_labels
tools.description: List the account's labels, one name per line. Labels are created by passing them to taskhold_create or taskhold_begin.

tools.name: taskhold_get_summary
tools.description: Task counts by status, priority and who added them (human or agent). Returns the total and one list per grouping; counts top-level tasks only, not steps.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: taskhold_complete · Private data: taskhold_begin, taskhold_get, taskhold_create, taskhold_progress, taskhold_create_from_todo, taskhold_start, taskhold_complete · Public sink: taskhold_progress · Destructive: taskhold_complete, taskhold_block.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: taskhold_complete · Private data: taskhold_begin, taskhold_get, taskhold_create, taskhold_progress, taskhold_create_from_todo, taskhold_start, taskhold_complete · Public sink: taskhold_progress · Destructive: taskhold_complete, taskhold_block

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "taskhold_begin" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
